crossRefs.note: The men of Gibeon sent to Joshua at the camp at Gilgal, saying, “Don’t abandon your servants! Come up to us quickly and…
When all the kings who were beyond the Jordan, in the hill country, and in the lowland, and on all the shore of the…
they gathered themselves together to fight with Joshua and with Israel, with one accord.
In the fourth generation they will come here again, for the iniquity of the Amorite is not yet full.”
Make an uproar, you peoples, and be broken in pieces! Listen, all you from far countries: dress for battle, and be…
Take counsel together, and it will be brought to nothing; speak the word, and it will not stand, for God is with us.”

people.name: Amorites
people.line: Canaanite people group, enemies of Israel

people.name: Eglon
people.line: Amorite king of Lachish; city in Judah

people.name: Gibeon
people.line: Hivite city that tricked Joshua into a peace treaty.

people.name: Hebron
people.line: An important city in Judah; burial place of patriarchs.

people.name: Jarmuth
people.line: A Canaanite city, later allotted to Judah

people.name: Jerusalem
people.line: The capital of Israel, a holy city for three religions

translations.web: Therefore the five kings of the Amorites, the king of Jerusalem, the king of Hebron, the king of Jarmuth, the king of Lachish, and the king of Eglon, gathered themselves together and went up, they and all their armies, and encamped against Gibeon, and made war against it.
translations.bsb: So the five kings of the Amorites—the kings of Jerusalem, Hebron, Jarmuth, Lachish, and Eglon—joined forces and advanced with all their armies. They camped before Gibeon and made war against it.
